[[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] '''Sionver Boll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who served with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I assure you, this weapon will only affect droids.|Sionver Boll assures Palpatine of the electro-proton bomb's effectiveness|<ref name="ZB" />}}
A [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] of an alien [[Species/Legends|species]], Sionver Boll lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Dr. Boll and the [[Ministry of Science (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Ministry of Science]] were working on the antidote to the virus released by [[Zeta Magnus]] on the population of the planet [[Skye/Legends|Marat V]].<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

Sionver Boll designed and developed the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]],<ref name="BF">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> an explosive device that created a massive [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]]. In 22 BBY,<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the first deployment of the bomb during the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]] deactivated an entire [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] invasion force. However it opened a sink hole at the blast site which awakened a gargantuan [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]. In the ensuing rampage, the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] allies sustained heavy casualties.<ref name="ZB" />

[[File:Doctor_Boll.png|left|thumb|Boll during the Clone Wars]]
Even [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] failed to penetrate the creature's thick armor,<ref name="ZB" /> which led Boll and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to express interest in studying the beast for possible reproduction of its scales as indestructible armor. When the beast was brought to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be studied, Palpatine suggested that the beast should be killed as the process of removing its scales to study them was difficult and painful for the beast. Boll protested, stating that it was the last of its kind and there was a chance it might be sentient.<ref name="ZBS">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>

Palpatine wasn't convinced and told her he'd replace her if she wouldn't kill it, but the beast heard his comments, and expressed its rage,<ref name="ZBS" /> as it recognized him as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="ZBSC">{{SW|url=video/the-zillo-beast-strikes-back-episode-featurette|text="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back" Episode Featurette}}</ref> The Chancellor suggested killing the beast with the toxin produced from the Malastarian [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] that weakened it. Boll was able to turn the toxin into a
[[Gas bomb/Legends|poison gas]], but she did not produce enough and the Zillo Beast escaped, beginning a [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|rampage]] on Coruscant to find Palpatine, who had ordered him tortured.<ref name="ZBS" />

Palpatine contacted Boll, and ordered her to create more toxin to kill the creature. She succeeded, and the toxin was fired by several Republic gunships, killing the Zillo. The next morning, Palpatine ordered Boll to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] the beast, much to her surprise.<ref name="ZBS" /> However, before Boll had the chance to create a clone the Clone Wars came to an end, and Palpatine no longer had need of Boll's skills.<ref name="FF-2014 7: Boll" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't worry. It will all be over soon.|Boll consoles the beast|<ref name="ZBS" />}}
Boll was a caring individual. She expressed her desire to let the beast live rather than killing it. Boll also dryly commented on the beast's reaction to Palpatine's comment on the intelligence of the creature. She additionally consoled the Zillo shortly prior to beginning the execution.<ref name="ZBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sionver Boll was voiced by [[Cara Pifko]],<ref name="ZBEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode218.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast}}</ref> who also voiced [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu Lawquane]].<ref name="TDEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}}</ref>
